facts.fact: Q2FY27 business update: disbursements ~₹16,490 cr (+22% YoY), business assets ~₹1,46,300 cr, collection efficiency 97% (96% a year earlier).

Q2FY27 results (Screener consolidated, Sep-2026 quarter): revenue ₹5,936 cr (+18% YoY), PAT ₹911 cr (+61% YoY), EPS ₹6.54; Sep-2026 half-year balance sheet: borrowings ₹1,49,579 cr, net worth ₹27,487 cr.

Post-Q2 broker notes: Motilal Oswal Buy ₹375 (cut from ₹430, 'rising CoF to weigh on NIM'); Emkay Buy ₹370 (Sep-27 TP, cut from ₹410; 'margins and regulations key to watch'); ICICI Securities Buy ₹415; Prabhudas Lilladher ₹350 (SOTP).
IMD end-of-season summary: June-September rainfall 87% of the long-period average (deficient), the weakest monsoon since 2015.
Sep-2026 shareholding: promoters 52.48%, FIIs 9.95%, DIIs 31.56%, public 5.97%.
Credit ratings reaffirmed by CRISIL, CARE and India Ratings; ₹876 cr of NCDs placed at 8.45%; share price ~₹288 (20-Nov-2026); Trendlyne consensus target ₹363.25 (21-Nov-2026).
